sentences.text: Under Sections 498A/302/34 ... vs In Re : Kaji Soyel @

Soyel Kaji on 23 March, 2023
23.03.2023 tkm/ct 28 C.R.M. (Db) 1071 of 2023 sl no.46 In Re : An application for bail under
section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Kaliachak P.S case no. 75 of 2021
dated 21.1.2021 under sections 498A/302/34 of the Ipc And In Re : Kaji Soyel @ Soyel Kaji ........
petitioner Mr. Debasis Sur Mr. H Halder Mr. D K Das ...... for the petitioner Mr. S G Mukherjee, ld
Pp Mr. P P Das Mrs. Manasi Roy ...... for the State Petitioner is in custody for about 880 days.
Learned lawyer for the State opposes the bail prayer.
We have considered the materials on record.
Victim housewife was throttled to death at the matrimonial home.
Petitioner who is her husband was present at the place of occurrence.
He has offered no explanation regarding the homicidal death.
In view of the aforesaid incriminating materials and the gravity of offence, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, prayer for bail is rejected.

Trial court is requested to expedite the trial and conclude the same at an early date preferably within two years from the next date fixed for recording evidence without granting unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.

(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
